hypothesis: The Icarus Verilog 12 abort is caused by packed multi-dimensional vector writes in the ROB/IQ/LSQ queue arrays, e.g. `rob_data[wr_idx] <= ...` where `rob_data` is declared as `logic [ENTRIES-1:0][PAYLOAD_W-1:0]`. Icarus interprets indexing into a packed dimension as an entire-array or array-slice write, producing the repeated 12-line 'Assignment to an entire array or to an array slice is not yet supported' errors around lines 1184-1195. The following elab_expr.cc packed_dimensions assertion is triggered while elaborating that incompatible indexed LHS. Previous repairs removed similar array-slice writes from dcache/icache/branch_predictor/prf, but the same unsupported style remains in reorder-buffer writeback/allocation, issue-queue capture/wakeup, and load-store-queue payload shifting. The fix must flatten these queue payloads to one-dimensional packed vectors or scalar unpacked arrays with explicit per-entry write enables, avoiding any base-index LHS on a packed multi-dimensional vector.
constraints: Do not change any frozen module ports or valid/ready/squash/epoch handshake semantics
Preserve synchronous reset behavior: all registered state and outputs must be 0 while rst_n is low
Use only Icarus Verilog 12 -g2012 supported constructs: no whole-array or array-slice writes, no packed multi-dimensional vector indexed LHS, no variable part-selects
Maintain one retirement per cycle and ROB/IQ program-order semantics
verification_targets: Compile and elaborate the full design with Icarus Verilog 12 (-g2012) with zero 'Assignment to an entire array or to an array slice' errors
No elab_expr.cc packed_dimensions assertion or core dump during elaboration
Teacher TB compile reaches simulation rather than aborting at compile/elaboration
